name: Bobtail
pricing: Home page: negotiable rates, max 3.24%. FAQ: usually 1.5% to 3.5%
summary: App-based factoring with a fuel card, aimed at owner-operators and small fleets, with same-day pay included.
differentiator: Bobtail's own pages disagree on two points that matter at signing: the home page caps the rate at 3.24% while the factoring FAQ says rates usually run 1.5% to 3.5%, and the home page promises no long-term commitment for the first 90 days while the FAQ says you move into a long-term contract after the 90-day trial. Ask which applies to you, in writing.

terms.rate: Home page: "Negotiable Rates, Max 3.24%". FAQ: "A small factoring fee (usually 1.5%-3.5%) is charged per invoice. Rates vary based on volume and credit risk."
terms.contract: Home page: "No Long-Term Commitment for the First 90 Days". FAQ: "After a 90-day trial period, Bobtail moves you into a long-term contract."
terms.transfers: Same-day pay, no extra charge; "Expedited payments require an additional fee; however, all other same-day and next-day payments are free."
terms.otherFees: No reserve requirements, no hidden fees (FAQ)
terms.speed: Invoices before 11 AM EST Monday to Friday are funded the same day by 6 PM EST

costModel.note: The 3.24% maximum on the home page. The FAQ says rates can run to 3.5%.

bestFor: Owner-operators who want free same-day pay and no reserve.
skipIf: You need a month-to-month contract after 90 days; the FAQ describes a long-term one.
